open_points.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - assemble_mapped_lists: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build, for each MappedList in the order given, the list its elements' outputs make in element order, and write and publish nothing: a value list is one StoredValue whose bytes are canonical_bytes of the JSON array text made of the elements' stored bytes — each read with read_value_bytes — in element order, separated by commas, between [ and ], whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the elements' StoredValues — read through read_records with one RecordsById naming their value_ids —, its value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent; a file list is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements' SpooledFilesRefs.
open_points.question: Must MappedList elements be restricted to StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef according to the port carriage, or must assemble_mapped_lists define behavior for FileFactsRef elements, whose files are FileFacts rather than SpooledFileKey values?

open_points.subject: deliver_input
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - deliver_input: [BEHAVIOR] MUST resolve the source to exactly one of two results before the check: a written StoredValue together with its canonical bytes, or a SpooledFilesRef; each result is checked and returned where it is resolved, with the StoredValue, the bytes and the files it was resolved with, so no value that might still be None reaches fit_port_value, a JsonCandidate or a BytesContent.
open_points.question: Must RecordedSource.ref and any RecordedSource used through ListElementSource be restricted to StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef, or must deliver_input support the permitted FileFactsRef variant despite the requirement that it resolve to exactly one of only two results?

open_points.subject: record_flow_output RecordedSource
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - record_flow_output: [BEHAVIOR] A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7). A RefusedError or StoreInternalError from put_value_bytes and a failed record_change are broken invariants raised as StoreInternalError.
open_points.question: Must a RecordedSource accepted by record_flow_output be restricted to a StoredValuesRef, or how can the function read value_id from the permitted SpooledFilesRef and FileFactsRef variants, which have no value_id field?

open_points.subject: record_flow_output MappedListSource
open_points.text: - AssembledList discriminated union on field 'list_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): AssembledValueList (list_kind='value'), AssembledFileList (list_kind='files'); a value of AssembledList is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and AssembledList itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - record_flow_output: [BEHAVIOR] A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7). A RefusedError or StoreInternalError from put_value_bytes and a failed record_change are broken invariants raised as StoreInternalError.
open_points.question: Must MappedListSource.list be restricted to AssembledValueList for record_flow_output, or how can an AssembledFileList satisfy the requirement to publish its StoredValue when that variant has only port and ref fields?
